[[Shield of the Hierophant]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[shield]] obtained from the [[Hierophant's Chest]], which spawns after defeating [[Duncan the Black]] in [[Slavers' Exile]].

==Stats==
:[[Armor rating|Armor]]: 16 (Requires 9 [[Tactics]])
:Received [[physical damage]] -5 (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as an undyed [[Amethyst Aegis]]. <!-- yellow is default color, could possibly also be dyed orange or red, very hard to figure out. Compare with Image:Amethyst_Aegis_dye_chart.jpg -->

==Replica==
Except for the visual appearance, exact technical replicas for this item are:
*[[Adamantine Shield]] from crafters [[Aksah]], [[Asiri]], [[Hahbe]], or [[Kol Swordshanks]] or collector [[Nikun]]
*[[Bronze Shield]] from crafters [[Manzo]], [[Honglei Sun]], [[Mathilde]], [[Gertrud]], [[Theodosus]], or [[Telamon]]
*[[Wooden Buckler]] from collector [[Healer Silja]]

==Unique counterparts==
*[[Aegis of the Condemned]], [[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Tactics)]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Tactics Shield]], [[Droknar's Tactics Shield]], [[Mallyx's Defense]], and [[Sunreach's Shield]] have stats identical to this item.
*[[Exalted Aegis (unique)|Exalted Aegis (Strength)]], [[Droknar's Strength Shield]], [[Deldrimor Shield (unique)|Deldrimor Strength Shield]], [[Shield of the Kinslayer]], and [[Mallyx's Courage]] have stats identical to this item but require [[Strength]].
